features.title: Supabase Schema: cios_pipeline_runs, cios_content_briefs, cios_insight_log, cios_distribution_queue
features.description: Apply migrations to create all 4 CIOS tables with correct indexes. Especially: composite index on pipeline_runs(run_type, started_at DESC), partial index on insight_log for unreviewed items, content_briefs filtered by platform and production_status.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 tables created in Supabase ivhfuhxorppptyuofbgq
Partial index on cios_insight_log(reviewed_at) WHERE reviewed_at IS NULL
cios_content_briefs.production_status enum: draft, in_production, published, cancelled
cios_pipeline_runs.steps JSONB column stores step-by-step execution trace

features.title: CIOS Orchestration API — FastAPI Scaffold (port 5570)
features.description: Scaffold cios_api.py in media-vault/backend. FastAPI app on port 5570 with CORS enabled for dashboard. Startup health check pings all 6 subsystems. /api/cios/health endpoint aggregates all subsystem statuses with individual latency measurements.
acceptance_criteria: FastAPI starts with: uvicorn cios_api:app --port 5570
GET /api/cios/health returns status, subsystems dict, pipeline_queue_depth
Individual subsystem status is 'ok', 'degraded', or 'down'
Health check completes within 3 seconds total

features.title: Content Brief Pipeline — Parallel Context Retrieval (Steps 1-3)
features.description: POST /api/cios/pipeline/content-brief — Steps 1, 2, 3 run in parallel via asyncio.gather(): AIL semantic query for topic context, TikTok analytics performance context for platform+niche, media-vault B-roll search. Results combined into context object for Step 4.
acceptance_criteria: Steps 1-3 run concurrently (not sequentially) — verified via timing logs
Each step has independent timeout (600ms, 300ms, 500ms) with graceful fallback to empty result
Combined context passed to Step 4 regardless of individual step failures
cios_pipeline_runs.steps records start_time and latency_ms for each step

features.title: Content Brief Pipeline — GPT-4o Brief Generation (Step 4)
features.description: Using all retrieved context from Steps 1-3, call GPT-4o with structured prompt to generate ContentBrief JSON: topic, platform, format, hook, hook_alternatives(2), script_outline, caption, hashtags, cta, visual_notes, broll_file_ids, estimated_duration, content_pillars, ail_insights(3).
acceptance_criteria: All ContentBrief fields populated for any valid topic + platform input
hook_alternatives contains exactly 2 alternatives
ail_insights contains up to 3 summarized retrieval results
broll_file_ids references actual media vault item IDs from Step 3

features.title: Content Brief Pipeline — GEO Optimization Step (Step 5)
features.description: When geo_optimize=true and platform=tiktok: call tiktok-geo /api/geo/generate-brief with the brief topic, merge geo_brief and geo_score into the cios_content_briefs row. Step 5 runs after Step 4 (sequential, not parallel).
acceptance_criteria: GEO step only runs when geo_optimize=true
geo_score stored in cios_content_briefs.geo_optimized and geo_brief fields
Step 5 failure does not fail the entire pipeline (brief returned without GEO data)
Total pipeline < 20 seconds even with GEO step

features.title: Performance Sync Pipeline
features.description: POST /api/cios/pipeline/performance-sync — calls media-vault /api/performance/check-all and tiktok-analytics /api/posts/check-batch in parallel. For each item with tier change: calls AIL /api/ingest/social to re-embed updated performance data. Generates cios_insight_log entries for tier changes.
acceptance_criteria: Vault and TikTok checkbacks run in parallel
Every performance tier change triggers AIL re-ingest
Tier upgrades to 'viral' generate insight_log entry with priority='high'
Returns { items_synced, tier_changes, insights_generated } count

features.title: Weekly Digest Pipeline
features.description: POST /api/cios/pipeline/weekly-digest — runs 5 data gathering steps, synthesizes via GPT-4o into structured digest (goals gaps, emerging formats, viral roundup, performance summary, unreviewed insights), sends via Resend if send_email=true.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 data gathering steps complete (with graceful fallback if any subsystem down)
GPT-4o synthesis generates coherent weekly narrative under 800 words
Email sent via Resend with HTML + plain text fallback
Digest JSON stored in cios_pipeline_runs.output for review

features.title: Goal Alignment Scan Pipeline
features.description: POST /api/cios/pipeline/goal-align — delegates to AIL /api/query/goals-align, writes each action item as a cios_insight_log entry of type 'goal_gap' with correct priority mapping (high/medium/low). Returns same action list.
acceptance_criteria: AIL goal-align response correctly converted to insight_log entries
Duplicate insights (same action within 7 days) not re-created
Priority mapped: AIL 'high' → CIOS 'high', etc.
Returns insights_created count alongside action list

features.title: Supabase Realtime Event Bus — cios-events Channel
features.description: Implement CIOS Event Bus using Supabase Realtime broadcast channel 'cios-events'. CIOS Orchestration API publishes typed events after key state changes. Dashboard subscribes to show live updates. Performance sync publishes PERFORMANCE_UPDATED events for viral tier changes.
acceptance_criteria: PIPELINE_COMPLETED event broadcast after every pipeline run finishes
PERFORMANCE_UPDATED event broadcast when performance_tier changes
INSIGHT_GENERATED event broadcast when new insight_log entry created
Dashboard receives events within 500ms of publish

features.title: CIOS Dashboard — Command Center Page (/)
features.description: Next.js page at / showing: 5 pipeline launcher cards with Run Now buttons, live pipeline run stream via Supabase Realtime, last 5 content briefs with status badges, unreviewed insight log entries (critical+high), system health dots for all 6 subsystems.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline run stream updates in real time without page refresh
Running pipeline shows step-by-step progress via cios_pipeline_runs.steps
System health dots turn red/yellow/green based on /api/cios/health response
Dashboard loads in < 2 seconds

features.title: CIOS Dashboard — Content Brief Library (/briefs)
features.description: Page showing all cios_content_briefs with filters (platform, format, geo_optimized, production_status). Expandable rows show full brief, B-roll thumbnails, and AIL context snippets. Actions: Start Production, Approve for Queue, Archive.
acceptance_criteria: Paginated at 20 per page with URL-synced filters
Expanded row shows broll_suggestions as thumbnail images
Approve for Queue button creates cios_distribution_queue entry
Archive sets production_status='cancelled'

features.title: CIOS Dashboard — Intelligence Insight Log (/intelligence)
features.description: Feed of cios_insight_log entries sorted by priority then created_at. Filter by type (viral_pattern, format_emerging, geo_citation, goal_gap, etc.), priority, and source_service. Mark as reviewed + action_taken note inline.
acceptance_criteria: Unreviewed insights shown at top with highlight border
Mark reviewed button sets reviewed_at to NOW() without page reload
Action taken text field saves to insight_log.action_taken
Count badge shows unreviewed critical + high priority items

features.title: CIOS Dashboard — Cross-Platform Performance Analytics (/performance)
features.description: Unified analytics view combining tiktok_posts and media_items.performance_data. Shows aggregate by platform (avg views, engagement_rate), by content format, and by niche tag. Top 10 performers table. Viral rate funnel chart.
acceptance_criteria: Aggregates data from both tiktok_posts and media_items.performance_data
Platform breakdown shows all 4 platforms (TikTok, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn)
Viral rate funnel: published count → strong+ count → viral count
Date range filter: last 7d / 30d / 90d / all time

features.title: CIOS Dashboard — Distribution Queue (/queue)
features.description: Page showing cios_distribution_queue contents with scheduling status, priority scores, and planned publish times. Manual Publish Now button calls Blotato directly. Calendar view toggle shows posts on scheduled dates.
acceptance_criteria: Queue items sortable by priority_score and scheduled_for
Publish Now button calls Blotato /v2/posts API and updates status='published'
Calendar view shows scheduled items on correct date cells
Drag-to-reorder adjusts priority_score of affected items

features.title: CIOS Dashboard — AIL Memory Browser (/memory)
features.description: Page to browse and manage the AIL. Namespace selector dropdown. Document list with source_type icons and chunk counts. Search bar calls AIL /api/query and shows ranked results. Ingest forms for YouTube URL and file upload. Obsidian sync trigger button.
acceptance_criteria: Namespace selector shows all namespaces from ail_documents
Search results render with source_type, title, similarity score, and content excerpt
YouTube ingest form: paste URL → shows video_title + chunks_created on success
Obsidian sync trigger POSTs to AIL /api/ingest/obsidian with default vault path

features.title: Autonomous Morning Cycle
features.description: When autonomous-cycle mode is active, run at 8am: goal-align pipeline, then 3 × content-brief pipeline (one per target platform from business-goals.json), then check distribution queue and auto-fill empty slots. Log cycle results to cios_insight_log.
acceptance_criteria: Cycle triggers at 8am local time (cron or pg_cron)
Platform selection reads from business-goals.json priority_platforms array
Auto-fill adds to queue only if < 3 items scheduled for next 24h
Cycle run logged as cios_pipeline_run with run_type='morning_cycle'

features.title: Autonomous Evening Cycle
features.description: When autonomous-cycle mode active, run at 6pm: performance-sync pipeline (updates all analytics), then creator-scan via tiktok-creator-watch, then generate insight_log entries from any viral_pattern or format_emerging events detected.
acceptance_criteria: Cycle triggers at 6pm local time
Creator scan calls tiktok-creator-watch /api/creators/scan-all
viral_pattern insights created for any creator posts with views > 100K
format_emerging insights created if emerging-formats returns any 'rising' formats

features.title: CIOS Launch Script (harness/launch-cios.sh)
features.description: Bash script that starts all CIOS subsystems in dependency order: media-vault backend → TikTok intelligence services → CIOS orchestration API → CIOS dashboard. Waits for each service health check before starting next. Logs PIDs to /tmp/cios-pids.txt.
acceptance_criteria: Script completes without error when all services are available
Each service health-checked before proceeding to next start
All PIDs written to /tmp/cios-pids.txt for tracking
Final output: 'All services started. Health: http://localhost:5570/api/cios/health'

features.title: Auto-Insight Generation for Viral Events
features.description: When tiktok-analytics classifies a post as 'viral' (performance_tier = 'viral'), automatically broadcast CREATOR_WENT_VIRAL event via Supabase Realtime, create cios_insight_log entry (type='viral_pattern', priority='high'), and trigger AIL ingest of the post content + hook.
acceptance_criteria: Viral classification in tiktok-analytics triggers event bus broadcast within 1 second
cios_insight_log entry created with post hook, views, and link to tiktok_posts record
AIL ingest called with platform='tiktok', including performance metrics
Insight appears on dashboard Command Center without page refresh

features.title: CIOS Pipeline Run History and Replay
features.description: GET /api/cios/pipelines returns all cios_pipeline_runs sorted by started_at DESC, paginated. POST /api/cios/pipelines/:run_id/replay re-runs the same pipeline with identical input. Failed runs show error and which step failed.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/cios/pipelines returns paginated runs with status and total_latency_ms
Replay creates a NEW cios_pipeline_runs row (not overwrites the original)
Failed run detail shows step name and error message for the failed step
Replay endpoint returns 404 for non-existent run_id

features.title: Content Brief → Production Status Workflow
features.description: State machine for cios_content_briefs.production_status: draft → in_production → published (or cancelled). PATCH /api/cios/briefs/:id/status endpoint with allowed transitions. 'in_production' triggers optional voiceover generation via video-studio MCP.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid state transitions return 400 with explanation
draft → in_production: optionally calls remotion_generate_voiceover with brief.full_script
in_production → published: requires blotato_post_id to be set
Status change triggers BRIEF_CREATED event on event bus

features.title: Cross-Subsystem Search Endpoint
features.description: GET /api/cios/search?q={query} — fans out search to AIL (/api/query), tiktok_posts (text search on caption), media_items (text search on ai_analysis), and cios_content_briefs (text search on topic+caption). Returns unified ranked results with source labels.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 sources queried in parallel
Results merged and re-ranked by relevance (similarity or text rank)
Each result labeled with source: 'ail' | 'tiktok' | 'vault' | 'brief'
Returns top 20 results total across all sources

features.title: Prospect Brief Integration with CRMLite
features.description: POST /api/cios/pipeline/prospect-brief — after AIL generates prospect brief, also fetch contact record from CRMLite API (if contact_name exists in crm_contacts), merge CRM data (last DM date, platform handle, status) into brief. Return enriched brief.
acceptance_criteria: CRMLite lookup by contact name returns matching contact or null
CRM data merged: last_dm_date, platform_handle, crm_status, notes
Brief includes crm_enriched: true/false field
CRM lookup failure is non-blocking (returns brief without CRM data)

features.title: Distribution Queue Auto-Scheduler with Thompson Sampling
features.description: When items are approved for the distribution queue, auto-assign scheduled_for times using Thompson Sampling over historical best-performing publish times (from tiktok_posts + media_items performance_data). Avoid scheduling 2 posts within 3 hours on same platform.
acceptance_criteria: Thompson Sampling reads historical performance by hour from tiktok_posts + media_items
Probability sampling produces times skewed toward historically high-performing hours
3-hour minimum gap enforced per platform
Scheduled times store Thompson Sampling confidence in cios_distribution_queue.metadata

features.title: CIOS ACD MCP Tool: acd_dispatch Integration
features.description: Expose a CIOS pipeline trigger as an ACD MCP-compatible tool so the ACD harness can dispatch content intelligence tasks. POST /api/cios/mcp/dispatch accepts { pipeline_type, input } and returns { run_id }. Registers with ACD memory layer on completion.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/cios/mcp/dispatch with valid pipeline_type starts correct pipeline
run_id returned immediately (pipeline runs async)
On pipeline completion, writes summary to AIL /api/ingest/conversation as agent_id='cios'
Supported pipeline_types: content-brief, performance-sync, goal-align, weekly-digest
